stories.title: How GTA started its own moral panic – video
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto's role in moral panic over graphic video games has been described by some experts as the “grand theft fallacy.” A Guardian video says the studio seeded the original controversy in 1997 to generate hype and taboo curiosity, with the effects still evident nearly 30 years later.

links.headline: How GTA started its own moral panic – video
links.excerpt: Grand Theft Auto has been so central to the moral panic over graphic video games that some experts have called it the "grand theft fallacy".
